Skip to content
A new choice.
Support what comes next.

Advertising revenue supports Floorp development and operation. You can now choose how release notes open and how blockers work on the Floorp blog.

Your settings stay as they are until you save a selection. You can change it later in Updates & Experiments.

Choose how release notes open

Choose automatic display after updates and how your blockers work on the Floorp blog.

Do not open automatically
Do not open release notes after updates. Keep your blocker settings when visiting the blog.
Open with my blocker settings
Selected
Keep your extensions working as configured. This does not install or enable an ad blocker.
Allow ads to support Floorp
Restrict uBlock Origin, AdGuard, Adblock Plus, AdBlock and Ghostery on the Floorp blog.
Scope when allowing advertising

The restriction applies to all HTTPS pages on blog.floorp.app, including manually opened pages, and affects tracking protection and custom filters as well as ad blocking. Other extensions are not restricted by this setting. Ads may still be blocked by other protection tools. Reload open blog pages after changing the setting.

Read about our funding and this setting (Japanese)

Current setting: Open with my blocker settings
Your selection takes effect only when you confirm. Closing this page keeps your current setting.

Not now
Save selection
